description: Turn a decision plus its options into a structured, async-friendly decision record (ADR): context, options with tradeoffs, the decision, and its reversibility. Write the decision down so others can follow it without a meeting.

context.description: Background: what forces this decision now.

decision.description: The decision to be made, in one line.

options.description: Candidate options. Two or three is plenty.

name: draft_decision_doc
